candidates.label: Quranic revelation affirmed as truth despite majority disbelief
candidates.definition: In 13:1: These are verses of the Book and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth but most of mankind do not believe.

evidence.excerpt: الٓمٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِۗ وَٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Haqq as defining attribute of revelation.

candidates.label: Cosmic architecture without visible pillars as divine power sign
candidates.definition: In 13:2: Allah erected heavens without pillars that you see then established Himself above Throne.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمۡ تُوقِنُونَ

candidates.label: Natural diversity from unified water source as ecological sign
candidates.definition: In 13:4: From all fruits He made two mates; neighboring plots gardens vines crops palms single root or otherwise nourished by one water yet We distinguish some over others in taste.

evidence.excerpt: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قِطَعٞ مُّتَجَٰوِرَٰتٞ وَجَنَّـٰتٞ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَزَرۡعٞ وَنَخِيلٞ صِنۡوَانٞ وَغَيۡرُ صِنۡوَانٖ يُسۡقَىٰ بِمَآءٖ وَٰحِدٖ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعۡضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلۡأُكُلِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Variety from unity as divine signature.

candidates.label: Resurrection denial contrasted with observable creation power
candidates.definition: In 13:5: If you are astonished then astonishing is their saying when we are dust will we be in new creation? Those disbelieved in their Lord.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَإِن تَعۡجَبۡ فَعَجَبٞ قَوۡلُهُمۡ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٍۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَاقِهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

candidates.label: Conditional divine response principle linking human change to divine change
candidates.definition: In 13:11: Indeed Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.

evidence.excerpt: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٞ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ يَحۡفَظُونَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوۡمٖ سُوٓءٗا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Human initiative as precondition for divine response.

candidates.label: Guardian angels as successive protectors by divine decree
candidates.definition: In 13:11: For each one are successive angels before and behind him who protect him by decree of Allah.

evidence.excerpt: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٞ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ يَحۡفَظُونَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوۡمٖ سُوٓءٗا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ

candidates.label: Thunder-lightning as dual fear-hope natural phenomena
candidates.definition: In 13:12-13: He shows lightning causing fear and aspiration generates heavy clouds; thunder exalts with praise of Him.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Meteorological signs carrying dual emotional valence.

candidates.label: Exclusive validity of divine supplication versus futile idol-worship
candidates.definition: In 13:14: To Him alone is supplication of truth; those called besides Him respond with nothing like one extending hands to water that never reaches mouth.

evidence.excerpt: لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسۡتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَيۡءٍ إِلَّا كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيۡهِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Da'wah al-haqq as exclusive divine prerogative.

candidates.label: Universal prostration of creation including shadows
candidates.definition: In 13:15: To Allah prostrates whoever is in heavens and earth willingly or by compulsion and their shadows in mornings and evenings.

evidence.excerpt: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ۩

candidates.label: Rain-parable distinguishing enduring truth from vanishing falsehood
candidates.definition: In 13:17: Torrent carries rising foam; ornaments and vessels melt producing foam similarly; thus Allah presents truth and falsehood — foam vanishes but what benefits people remains.

evidence.excerpt: أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَالَتۡ أَوۡدِيَةُۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحۡتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيۡلُ زَبَدٗا رَّابِيٗاۖ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلنَّارِ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ حِلۡيَةٍ أَوۡ مَتَٰعٖ زَبَدٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَٱلۡبَٰطِلَۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذۡهَبُ جُفَآءٗۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمۡكُثُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ

candidates.label: Covenant-breaking as severing divine bonds and spreading corruption
candidates.definition: In 13:25: Those who break covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever what Allah ordered joined and spread corruption upon earth — for them is curse and evil home.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

candidates.label: Dhikr as unique heart-assurance mechanism for believers
candidates.definition: In 13:28: Those who believed and whose hearts are assured by remembrance of Allah — unquestionably by remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ

candidates.label: Provision expansion-restriction as divine prerogative beyond human control
candidates.definition: In 13:26: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts it; they rejoice in worldly life while worldly life compared to Hereafter is only brief enjoyment.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ وَفَرِحُواْ بِٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٞ

candidates.label: Prophetic consolation through historical precedent of ridiculed messengers
candidates.definition: In 13:32: Already were messengers ridiculed before you and I extended time for disbelievers then seized them — how was My penalty.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

candidates.label: Divine decree supremacy over human plotting
candidates.definition: In 13:42: Those before them plotted but to Allah belongs plan entirely; He knows what every soul earns.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ جَمِيعٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡكُفَّـٰرُ لِمَنۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Reliance on divine plan over human schemes.

candidates.label: Arabic legislation as final revelation with post-revelation warning
candidates.definition: In 13:37: Thus We revealed it as Arabic legislation; if you follow their inclinations after knowledge has come to you have neither ally nor protector from Allah.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمًا عَرَبِيّٗاۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بَعۡدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا وَاقٖ

candidates.label: Umm al-Kitab as divine master record underlying elimination-confirmation
candidates.definition: In 13:39: Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms and with Him is Mother of the Book.

evidence.excerpt: يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ

candidates.label: Territorial reduction as visible geopolitical sign of divine authority
candidates.definition: In 13:41: Have they not seen We set upon land reducing it from its borders? Allah decides and there is no adjuster of His decision.

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

candidates.label: Messenger's duty limited to notification while accountability belongs to Allah
candidates.definition: In 13:40: Whether We show you part of what We promise or take you in death upon you is only notification and upon Us is the account.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡحِسَابُ

candidates.label: Closing witness formula invoking Allah and Scripture-knowers as sufficient testimony
candidates.definition: In 13:43: Those who disbelieved say you are not a messenger; say sufficient is Allah as witness between me and you and whoever has knowledge of the Scripture.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسۡتَ مُرۡسَلٗاۚ قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ
